#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int num = 0;
    bool negative = false;
    char ch;
    while (cin.get(ch)) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            negative = true;
            break;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            num = ch - '0';
            while (cin.get(ch) && ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    return negative ? -num : num;
}

struct Test {
    int rows, cols;
    vector<char> sequence;
    long long binomial[64][64];
    long long minDiff;
    vector<int> countA, countB;
    map<long long, long long> cacheMap;

    void explore(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = abs(x - y);
        if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - binomial[v1][rows] * binomial[v2][rows] >= minDiff) return;
        if (v1 == rows - 1 && v2 == rows - 1) {
            if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= rows) {
            long long deltaX = binomial[v1][rows] - binomial[v1 - 1][rows], deltaY = binomial[v2][rows];
            explore(x, y + deltaX * deltaY, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= rows) {
            long long deltaX = binomial[v1][rows], deltaY = binomial[v2][rows] - binomial[v2 - 1][rows];
            explore(x + deltaX * deltaY, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long long compute(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long key = x * 10000LL + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto cached = cacheMap.find(key);
        if (cached != cacheMap.end()) return cached->second;
        long long res = 0LL;
        long long d = abs(x - y);
        if (d - binomial[v1][rows] * binomial[v2][rows] > minDiff) {
            cacheMap[key] = res;
            return res;
        }
        if (v1 < rows || v2 < rows) {
            int sumIdx = v1 + v2;
            if (v1 >= countA[sumIdx] && v2 >= countB[sumIdx]) {
                v1 -= countA[sumIdx];
                v2 -= countB[sumIdx];
                res = binomial[v1 + v2][v1];
                cacheMap[key] = res;
                return res;
            }
            cacheMap[key] = res;
            return res;
        }
        char c = sequence[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long c1 = binomial[v1][rows] - binomial[v1 - 1][rows], s2 = binomial[v2][rows];
            res += compute(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long s1 = binomial[v1][rows], c2 = binomial[v2][rows] - binomial[v2 - 1][rows];
            res += compute(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cacheMap[key] = res;
        return res;
    }

    void run() {
        rows = readInt();
        cols = readInt();
        sequence.resize(rows + cols);
        for (int i = 0; i < rows + cols; i++) {
            sequence[i] = cin.get();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (rows + cols); j++) {
                if (j == 0) binomial[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) binomial[i][j] = 0;
                else binomial[i][j] = binomial[i - 1][j - 1] + binomial[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        int v1 = rows + cols, v2 = rows + cols;
        long long xCoord = 0, yCoord = 0;
        while (v1 >= rows && v2 >= rows) {
            if (xCoord > yCoord) {
                long long c1 = binomial[v1][rows] - binomial[v1 - 1][rows], s2 = binomial[v2][rows];
                yCoord += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long s1 = binomial[v1][rows], c2 = binomial[v2][rows] - binomial[v2 - 1][rows];
                xCoord += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        minDiff = abs(xCoord - yCoord);
        explore(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
        countA.assign(rows + cols + 1, 0);
        countB.assign(rows + cols + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
            countA[i + 1] = countA[i] + (sequence[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            countB[i + 1] = countB[i] + (sequence[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long answer = compute(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Test t;
    t.run();
    return 0;
}
